primitives.name: Dependency Vulnerability Audit
primitives.verbatim_quote: --description: Dependency and vulnerability audit allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash(git diff*), Bash(git log*), Bash(git status*), Bash(npm audit), Bash(npm audit --json*), Bash(npm audit --omit=dev*), Bash(npm audit --audit-level*) --Run the package audit and review dependencies.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'V': 'vulnerability count (dimensionless)', 'D': 'dependency set (set of package names)', 'C': 'CVE identifier (string)', 'T': 'time (seconds)'}
primitives.assumptions: Dependencies are represented as a finite set; audit results are deterministic per tool invocation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When V > 0, system enters risk-reduction mode.

layer2.mapping: Audit report structure maps to Bayesian belief update over dependency safety space.

primitives.name: Safe vs Breaking Update Classification
primitives.verbatim_quote: Separate "safe to bump" from "breaking — needs review." Report only; install nothing.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'safe update flag (boolean)', 'B': 'breaking change flag (boolean)', 'R': 'review required flag (boolean)'}
primitives.assumptions: Update classification is binary and contextually dependent on semantic versioning.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S ∨ B ∨ R = true, transition to review state.

layer2.mapping: Derived from audit signal thresholds; used to gate deployment logic.
